messages:
omar_procurement: FYI vendor just sent a revised ETA for PO 2026-07-23. Lead time pushed +3 weeks for H100 line items. They suggest splitting the allocation across FRA and AMS to keep some capacity live. Thoughts?

linda_ops: Oof. Which serials/shipments are affected? If FRA gets delayed by customs we should avoid concentrated risk.

omar_procurement: Affected POs: 2026-07-23, 2026-07-24. Vendor recommends 60/40 FRA/AMS. Carrier provided tentative AWBs: FRA AWB 1Z999FRA12345, AMS AWB 1Z999AMS67890.

jess_enginfra: If we split, can we pin the FRA batch to non-critical pools? We can't afford warm-spare depletion in na-west2. Prefer AMS for warm spares, FRA for long-tail.

kai_sre: Agree. Also need to consider cross-region egress and interconnect saturation — AMS->na-west2 will add ~12ms median for KV-cache warmups. Might affect tail latency for small-batch requests.

anna_logistics: Carrier note: FRA shipment currently on customs hold for "documentation clarification" (AWB 1Z999FRA12345). Carrier bot says ETA will slip until docs clear. RMA units flagged: RMA# RMA-98765 for 4 DOA units found at depot. They can either repair in depot or replace from AMS pool if available.

carrier_bot: Shipment update: AWB 1Z999FRA12345 - customs hold. Expected clearance ETA 72h after documents upload. To upload docs, email customs@carrier.example with PO and invoice PDFs.

linda_ops: For DOA RMA-98765 we need decision: expedite replacements from AMS (will increase freight by ~$6k) or accept depot repair (lead ~10 days). Which path?

omar_procurement: Cost tradeoff: expedited AMS replacements = +$6k freight + small swap logistics. Depot repair = vendor warranty covers labor but causes warm-spare gap risk. If we accept depot repair, we should escalate to vendor for temporary loaners.

jess_enginfra: Temporary loaners from vendor are ideal. Can procurement push for loaner commitment in writing? Also we should create a quick routing policy: route requests for pools backed by FRA-> fallback to AMS identical model variant automatically. I'll open a rollout config PR.

omar_procurement: I asked vendor for written loaner commitment and a partial-credit for expedited air. Waiting on confirmation.

kai_sre: Action items: 1) anna: upload customs docs for FRA now. 2) omar: get loaner commitment & pricing concession. 3) jess: config PR to pin FRA to low-priority pools and AMS as warm-spare. 4) linda: run short audit on spare counts and report if any pools fall below 2 warm spares.

anna_logistics: Uploading docs now to carrier portal and emailing customs@carrier.example. Will post confirmation here with timestamp.

omar_procurement: Vendor replied: "We can provide 4 loaner units available in AMS for 7 days, plus 30% freight credit on expedited air." Drafting PO amendment.

linda_ops: That sounds acceptable. If AMS loaners land in time we can avoid warm-spare depletion. I'll run inventory check and post numbers in ~30m.

jess_enginfra: Thanks — I'll start the rollout PR and include a fallback policy that switches to quantized-llama-variant if H100s are scarce for non-latency-critical routes.

kai_sre: Noted. Keep me looped on AMS arrival ETA so we can monitor tail latency during the switch.

anna_logistics: Customs cleared at 2026-08-04T09:12Z (uploaded docs at 2026-08-03T14:02Z). Carrier updated AWB 1Z999FRA12345 status to "in transit".

omar_procurement: Final: vendor confirmed loaners shipped from AMS via overnight (AWB 1Z999AMS00011). Freight credit applied to PO. Closing here unless issues — tag me if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
